rows: A fixed 3% annual increment on basic pay, reset roughly once a decade through a pay commission.
Cash CTC negotiated per hire, often below a stable mid-size company for the same skill, offset by an equity grant whose real value depends on the company eventually reaching a liquidity event.
Not applicable in the way it applies to a company, the employer does not go out of business.
About 90% of Indian startups do not survive past five years, and a large share of the funded ones that do survive still go through at least one layoff round tied to funding cycles.
Defined by seniority and department rules; responsibility grows on a fixed, slow timeline regardless of individual capability.

Often accelerated well beyond your job title in the first 12-18 months, because small teams cannot afford to keep responsibility narrow, the upside is faster skill-building, the downside is less structured mentorship.
